properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 4 at 2:32PM MDT by NWS Denver CO
properties.description:
At 232 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking a strong thunderstorm 5
miles south of Lake George, or 61 miles south of Denver, moving east
at 15 mph.

HAZARD...Landspouts, wind gusts up to 40 mph, and half inch size
hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Minor damage to outdoor objects is possible. Gusty winds
could knock down tree limbs and blow around unsecured
objects.

Locations impacted include...
Lake George.

properties.headline: Special Weather Statement issued August 4 at 2:25PM MDT by NWS Pueblo CO
properties.description:
At 224 PM MDT, Doppler radar was tracking strong thunderstorms along
a line extending from near Westcreek to near Florissant. Movement was
east at 30 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts up to 50 mph.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects.

Locations impacted include...
Woodland Park, Monument, Palmer Lake, Green Mountain Falls, Divide,
Crystola, Chipita Park, Florissant, and Cascade.
